name: mobile-debug-mcp
description: Mobile app debugging tools and usage guidance for Android and iOS agents.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and debug Android and iOS apps
interface.longDescription: Inspect mobile apps, interact with their screens, collect debugging evidence, and verify observed behaviour on Android and iOS devices and emulators. Requires local Node.js and the relevant platform toolchains.
defaultPrompt: Check my mobile debugging environment and connected devices.
Inspect the current screen of my mobile app.
Help me reproduce and diagnose a bug in my mobile app.
